en: I've been... so conceited all this time.{PAGE}I abused my power, believing that{SAUT}oppressing the citizens would benefit{SAUT}the whole of society...
But it's because of this power that{SAUT}I must not mistake the purpose of{SAUT}my authority!
The reborn Kamoshidaman shall never{SAUT}mistreat a troubled citizen again!
